description:
Place a phone call where the AI has an autonomous conversation about a given topic — scheduling, surveys, follow-ups, etc. No webhook setup needed.

The agent must have a phone number attached.
This MCP connector prepends an automated-assistant disclosure to the greeting sent to the API and adds AI identity instructions around the topic. No tool argument disables these additions, but they do not guarantee the model's behavior. Calls made directly through the AgentPhone API or SDKs bypass this connector's disclosure logic.
By default (wait=true) this waits for the call to finish — up to max_wait_seconds — and returns the call with its transcript. If that wait elapses first, it returns the call while it may still be in progress (check later with get_call). With wait=false it returns immediately with the call's ID and status, and you fetch the transcript later with get_call.

agent_id.description: The agent that will place the call (ID from list_agents). It must have a phone number attached.

from_number_id.description: ID of the specific number to call from (from list_numbers), when the agent has more than one.

initial_greeting.description: Text appended after the connector’s AI disclosure in the greeting sent to the API. If omitted, only the disclosure is sent.

max_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the call to finish before returning, in seconds, when wait=true.

to_number.description: The phone number to call, written in full international form with a country code, like +14155551234.

topic.description: The conversation goal for the assistant to pursue. Embedded as the call objective within connector-supplied AI identity instructions. These instructions guide the model; they do not guarantee its behavior. Be specific about what to discuss and any goals.

voice.description: A voice ID (from list_voices) to override the agent's default voice for this call.

wait.description: When true (default), blocks until the call ends and returns the full transcript.

name: make_conversation_call

outputSchema.description: The call, with transcript turns when available.

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call, or null.

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null if still active.

id.description: The call's unique ID (use as call_id in get_call).

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number used for the call.

status.description: Call status, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed.

items.description: One human/agent turn of the call transcript.

response.description: What the agent said in response, or null.

transcript.description: What the human said on this turn.

title: Make AI Conversation Call
